query:
SELECT 
  c.id,
  c.name AS contact_name,
  ccf.fieldName,
  ccf.fieldValue AS company_name
FROM contacts c
INNER JOIN users u ON c.parentUserId = u.id
INNER JOIN contact_custom_fields ccf ON c.id = ccf.contactId
WHERE u.username = 'Jiang' 
  AND ccf.fieldName = '公司名称'
  AND c.name IN ('王茜', '李晓洁', '羊仲平')
LIMIT 5;
